faqItems.question: How do I use my mask powers?
faqItems.answer:
You can activate your mask powers in two ways:

Method 1: Using chat commands

Simply type one of these commands in chat:

/mask power 1 — Activate Power 1.

/mask power 2 — Activate Power 2.

/mask power 3 — Activate Power 3.

Method 2: Using the Command Keys mod

You can also assign keyboard shortcuts to your powers so you don't have to type the commands every time.

Press K on your keyboard to open the Command Keys configuration. Choose the keys you want to use and assign the following commands:

Power 1: /mask power 1

Power 2: /mask power 2

Power 3: /mask power 3

Once configured, you can activate your powers using your chosen keys.

For a visual explanation, check out the YouTube tutorial: coming soon

faqItems.question: How many masks are included in MaskSMP?
faqItems.answer: MaskSMP currently includes 16 unique masks, each with three unique powers. Every mask offers a different playstyle, giving you more ways to approach combat, survival and PvP.

faqItems.question: Does every mask have different powers?
faqItems.answer: Yes! Each mask has its own set of three powers. Choose a mask that matches your playstyle and experiment with its abilities to discover what works best for you.

faqItems.question: Do I need the Command Keys mod to use my powers?
faqItems.answer:
No! The Command Keys mod is optional. You can use your powers by entering the commands directly in chat.

However, if you prefer activating your powers with keyboard shortcuts, you can install the Command Keys mod and configure your controls.

faqItems.question: How do I install MaskSMP?
faqItems.answer:
To install MaskSMP on your server:

1. Download the latest MaskSMP .jar file.

2. Place the file inside your server's plugins folder.

3. Restart your server.

4. Install the MaskSMP resource pack and any required client-side mods.

5. Join the server, equip a mask and start playing!

Make sure your Minecraft, server and plugin versions are compatible.

faqItems.question: Do I need the MaskSMP resource pack?
faqItems.answer:
The resource pack provides the custom mask models, textures and visual assets used by MaskSMP. Install the appropriate resource pack to experience the intended visuals.

You can find the resource pack download on the MaskSMP resource page.

faqItems.question: Can I upgrade my mask?
faqItems.answer: Yes! MaskSMP includes an upgrade system that lets you progress beyond simply choosing a mask. Check out the upgrade menu in-game to explore the available upgrades.

faqItems.question: Can I use MaskSMP on my own server?
faqItems.answer: Yes! MaskSMP is designed for Minecraft multiplayer servers, including SMP and PvP servers. The server owner needs to install the plugin and provide any required resource packs or client-side setup instructions.

faqItems.question: Why are my powers not working?
faqItems.answer:
First, make sure you have a mask equipped and that you're using the correct command for the power you want to activate.

If you're using keyboard shortcuts, check that Command Keys is installed correctly and that each key is assigned to the correct /mask power command.

If the problem continues, check your server and plugin versions or ask your server administrator for help.

faqItems.question: Can I enchant my mask?
faqItems.answer: Yes! MaskSMP includes an enchantment system that lets you customize your equipment and develop your preferred playstyle. Open the enchantment menu in-game to explore the available options.
